name: payment_request
description: Protected. Request payment of the total the rules gave on this call. On SIA (Konza): sends a DEMO payment prompt with a 6-digit code by SMS, or by a code call (deliver: call); the caller approves by telling you the code (payment_confirm). In Kenya: a mobile money PIN prompt. Only after the caller clearly said yes to that exact total. The amount must equal the rules total or it is refused. Returns payment_id.

permit_id.description: Permit renewals only: permit_id from permit_lookup. Leave out for anything else.

amount_kes.description: Kenyan services: the total in shillings from the rules tool on this call

amount.description: Other services: the total from the rules tool on this call, in the service's currency

confirmation_id.description: Only on country agents: leave empty the first time; after the caller says yes to the read-back, call again with the same arguments and the confirmation_id you were given.

deliver.description: SIA only: how the payment prompt reaches the phone on file. sms (default) or call send a 6-digit code; pesa is the mobile money PIN screen for smartphone users. Then call payment_confirm.

reference.description: SIA only, optional: the reference of the application to pay (for example SPS-4F2A9C1D) when the resident has more than one unpaid. Leave out to pay the newest.
